newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea bond yields close lower on bargain hunting.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea bond yields close lower on bargain hunting.

text.p: Benchmark three-year corporate bond yields closed lower on Monday on bargain hunting sparked by recent sharp rises in the yields, dealers said.
Three-month CD yields also closed lower on relatively scanty new issues, they said.
* 3-yr corporates close at 12.52 pct vs Saturday's 12.65
* 3-mth CDs end at 13.60 pct vs Saturday's 13.70
* Average overnight call rate at 13.0 pct vs 12.5 pct
